title: 7:11 Ask thee a sign. The sign was a prophecy that received both immediate and later fulfillment (8:3-7). In the Old Testament era, signs were "frequently offered by a prophet so that someone may know that God [was] fulfilling the promises he [had] made" 15 (37:30; 38:7; 1 Sam. 2:34; 10:7).
author: Tina M. Peterson
